extension.summary: Manage the Wi-Fi of LibreELEC, for the remote control
Gerencie o Wi-Fi do LibreELEC, pelo controle remoto
extension.description: Easy Connect manages the Wi-Fi of LibreELEC in the design of the Monteiro add-ons. It shows the network the device is connected to, with its signal, frequency, link speed, security, addresses and saved password; the networks in range, with their signal and a lock on the ones with a password, to connect with one press of OK; and the known networks, to connect, see the password, choose whether each one connects by itself or forget it. A button turns the Wi-Fi on and off. With the Monteiro skin, the Wi-Fi button of the home screen opens Easy Connect and shows the signal.

O Easy Connect gerencia o Wi-Fi do LibreELEC no visual dos add-ons Monteiro. Ele mostra a rede em que o aparelho está conectado, com o sinal, a frequência, a velocidade do link, a segurança, os endereços e a senha salva; as redes ao alcance, com o sinal e um cadeado nas que têm senha, para conectar com um OK; e as redes conhecidas, para conectar, ver a senha, escolher se cada uma conecta sozinha ou esquecê-la. Um botão liga e desliga o Wi-Fi. Com o skin Monteiro, o botão de Wi-Fi da tela inicial abre o Easy Connect e mostra o sinal.
extension.news: 1.0.2 - Connecting to a new network with a password works inside Kodi, which does not allow the way 1.0.1 started connmanctl. 1.0.1 - OK on a known network opens a modal with its signal, state, password and security, and buttons to connect, show the password, choose whether it connects by itself and forget it. 1.0.0 - First release.
